title: Dof bu am bëgg-bëgg bu rëy
intro: Tambali ci tukki ngir wane dàntite mbootaay bu mbootaay bi am ay pexe yu am doole yu mujjee am doole te kenn xamul woon. Léeb bii dafay fàttali nit ñi bu baax dooley boroom bi ak ni dooley àdduna bi daa yomba dagg sudee dafay xeex li sell. Fexeel leeral kumpa gi nekk ci mbooloo mi, ñu bind seen jaar-jaar ci Al Quran ngir artu képp ku bëgga réer.
clues: Nu am yéene yu rëy, gëm ni sunu doole amul fenn, nu dem ci tukki bu leer, mébet buy yàq.
Sunu njiit, fees dell ak réy-réy, dafa bëggoon yàq kër gu sell gi ñu bari jox cër, ngir soppi hajj màkka ci kër gi ñu tabaxoon.
Nu joge ci réew mu sori, nu dem ak doole ju bari, gëm ni dina ñu mëna dindi tabax bu yàgg bi nekkoon ci Dëkk bu Sell bi.
Sunu larme dafa am doole lool, ay mbindéef yu taaru ñoo ko jiite woon, muy lu ñu musul gis ci xare bu mel nii ci askanu réew mi ñu dugg.
Bi nu yeggee fi nu doon dem, Yàlla jàppale nu; mbindéef yu ndaw yu am laaf feeñ, dinu sànni xeer yuñ defaree ban buñ lakk.
Sunu tukki bi dafa mujjee am njeexte lu tiis, bàyyi sunu doole ju rëy ji jeex, melni ñax muñ sàqami, sunu pexe bu rëy bi mujjee nekk pënd.

outcome.label: Njureef
options: Ñu dàq leen ci seen réew

arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلْفِيلِ
verse: Have you not considered, [O Muḥammad], how your Lord dealt with the companions of the elephant? (105:1)
